## About this document

> **Known cosmetic limitation (PDF output only)**: page 1 of the
> rendered PDF is a stray, auto-generated title page carrying
> whichever transcluded chapter's own YAML title happened to win
> pandoc's last-wins frontmatter merge (harmless, but not the
> intended title) -- the correct title page is page 2 immediately
> after it (an explicit title block in this file's own body,
> `title-block-style: none` in the YAML did not suppress the stray
> page). Tried and reverted: `pdftools::pdf_subset()` to drop page 1
> -- it corrupted the embedded images/fonts (13 MB -> 190 KB, real
> "Unknown compression method" errors) and is NOT safe to use on
> this file; do not re-attempt without first confirming poppler/
> pdftools handles this specific lualatex output correctly. A real
> fix would need to strip YAML front matter from all 8 transcluded
> notebooks (like the annotated-bibliography workaround just above
> does for that one file) rather than just accepting the stray page.


This is a single, consolidated companion document assembled from the
project's living-reference notebooks (`notebooks/01`-`08`), each of
which is also maintained and rendered independently. It exists so the
full analytical narrative -- from instrumentation and data provenance
through statistical synthesis -- can be read start to finish, cited,
and shared as one file, alongside the project's annotated bibliography.

- **Source code and database pipeline**: <https://github.com/tylerirvin543/Steamboat_Creek_Geochemistry_Database>
- **Live documentation website**: <https://tylerirvin543.github.io/Steamboat_Creek_Geochemistry_Database/>
- **This document's source**: `notebooks/00_full_report.qmd` (re-render
  with `quarto::quarto_render("notebooks/00_full_report.qmd")`, or
  `quarto render notebooks/00_full_report.qmd --to pdf` from a shell)

Each chapter below is transcluded verbatim from its own standalone
notebook file (via Quarto's `{{< include >}}`) -- editing a chapter
here means editing the source `.qmd` in `notebooks/`, not this file.
Because several chapters query the live operational database and one
(PHREEQC) invokes a real external executable per sample, a full render
of this document re-executes all of that work and can take a
meaningful amount of time; see each chapter's own notebook for a
faster, standalone re-render during normal iteration.

```{r allow-duplicate-labels}
#| label: allow-duplicate-labels
#| echo: false
# Each source notebook below is also maintained/rendered as its own
# standalone document and so has its own "setup" (and other commonly-
# named) chunk. knitr requires document-wide-unique chunk labels once
# everything is merged via {{< include >}} -- this is the standard,
# documented way to combine several independent Rmd/qmd files into one
# without renaming every chunk in every source notebook.
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")
```

# Annotated Bibliography

```{r bibliography-body}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Read directly and strip the YAML front matter, rather than
# {{< include >}}, because a transcluded qmd's own YAML block
# (title/subtitle/author) silently overwrote this document's own
# title-page metadata via pandoc's last-wins frontmatter merge --
# confirmed by inspecting the rendered PDF's page 1 before this fix.
bib_path <- file.path("docs", "literature", "annotated_bibliography.qmd")
if (!file.exists(bib_path)) bib_path <- file.path("..", "docs", "literature", "annotated_bibliography.qmd")
bib_lines <- readLines(bib_path, warn = FALSE)
yaml_ends <- which(bib_lines == "---")
body_start <- if (length(yaml_ends) >= 2) yaml_ends[2] + 1 else 1
knitr::asis_output(paste(bib_lines[body_start:length(bib_lines)], collapse = "\n"))
```
